description: This file defines a class 'LogExtent' which represents a sealed log segment that manages a buffer, along with nested enumerator structures for iterating over log entries. It contains methods for resource management, enumeration, and reading log entry data from a buffer.

classes.name: LogExtent
classes.description: Represents a sealed log segment backed by a buffer, providing enumeration over log entries and resource management.

classes.name: LogExtent.EntryEnumerator
classes.description: Enumerator for iterating over entries within a LogExtent, implementing both IEnumerable and IEnumerator interfaces.

classes.name: LogExtent.Entry
classes.description: A record struct representing a log entry with a stream ID and payload.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to create an EntryEnumerator for a given LogExtent.

methods.name: MoveNext
methods.description: Advances the enumerator to the next log entry.

methods.name: Current
methods.description: Gets the current log entry the enumerator points to.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the enumerator to its initial position.
